title: Third meeting with Noe

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: My dear Icarus. How are those wings?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My dear Icarus. How are those wings?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Hello darling. How’s that strut coming along?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello darling. How’s that strut coming along?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: A small part of the Lily lives on. I'm so glad. I only wish I could go back there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A small part of the Lily lives on. I'm so glad. I only wish I could go back there.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: I’m toying with the idea of becoming an elegant ghost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m toying with the idea of becoming an elegant ghost.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Ugh no! Have you seen the fashions up there? All that chrome and grey. I’d wither like a radium rose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh no! Have you seen the fashions up there? All that chrome and grey. I’d wither like a radium rose.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Since you were such a good student last time, I’ll be teacher again. What’s it to be? Fiendishly tricky or nice and easy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Since you were such a good student last time, I’ll be teacher again. What’s it to be? Fiendishly tricky or nice and easy?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: You asked for it, Icarus. I’ll give you… the Ikasumi. The ingredients are special: Gin, Dry Vermouth, Squid Ink and Olives.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You asked for it, Icarus. I’ll give you… the Ikasumi. The ingredients are special: Gin, Dry Vermouth, Squid Ink and Olives.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: You should be able to handle a Nivalis Sunset. The ingredients are rum, tequila, mango, peach and oranges. A slice of paradise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should be able to handle a Nivalis Sunset. The ingredients are rum, tequila, mango, peach and oranges. A slice of paradise.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Good luck, cherie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck, cherie.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Like the rest of the world. Go on then, run along.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like the rest of the world. Go on then, run along.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: I’d give my best pair of vintage Dercloud heels for one more night with my old friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d give my best pair of vintage Dercloud heels for one more night with my old friends.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: No, Nivalis is my home. She always will be. Now, how do you feel about reviving another recipe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, Nivalis is my home. She always will be. Now, how do you feel about reviving another recipe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have the Ultra 64 ingredients for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have the Ultra 64 ingredients for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have the Ultra 64 ingredients for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have the Ultra 64 ingredients for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have obtained the Strawberry Stinger ingredients.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have obtained the Strawberry Stinger ingredients.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have obtained the Strawberry Stinger ingredients.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have obtained the Strawberry Stinger ingredients.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you thought anymore about what you’ll do now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you thought anymore about what you’ll do now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you thought anymore about what you’ll do now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you thought anymore about what you’ll do now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about retiring to Luna?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about retiring to Luna?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have any more recipes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have any more recipes?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you have any more recipes?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you have any more recipes?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enthusiastic!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enthusiastic!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, too busy right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, too busy right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tricky.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tricky.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Easy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Easy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Lily.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Lily.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nostalgia paints the past in brighter colors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nostalgia paints the past in brighter colors.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nostalgia paints the past in brighter colors.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nostalgia paints the past in brighter colors.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We can't go back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can't go back.
